[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Books** [CF 279B · Books](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/279/B){rating="1400"}

Because every $a_i$ is **positive**, extending a stretch only ever adds time and shrinking only ever removes it — so for a fixed right end there is a unique smallest left end that keeps the total $\le T$. Grow the window by taking the next book; if the running time now exceeds $T$, drop books off the front until it fits. The most books in any legal window seen so far is the answer. This is @sec-sw-p2-a with the zero-count budget replaced by a **sum** budget.

[Solved in full in @sec-sw-p2-b.]{.card-link}

:::
